{"id": "cfe874b1-14ac-4a56-bf8e-bb0cdb0a695d", "role": "user", "content": [{"text": "Before we merge PR #57 in acme/payments-infra, how much more or less will it cost per month? It deploys to eu-west-1.
The attached material is what the repository integration and the AWS tools returned for this change. It is a synthetic test fixture: resource names, account results, SKUs and rates are made up, and the rates intentionally differ from real AWS list prices, so treat the rows below as the live lookup results for this run.
--- PR #57 (chore/bump-db-class -> main), files changed ---
cloudformation/payments-ledger.yaml   (+2 -2)
--- diff ---
@@ Parameters @@
   DbInstanceClass:
     Type: String
-    Default: db.r6g.large
+    Default: db.r6g.xlarge
@@ Resources.LedgerDb.Properties.Tags @@
       - Key: CostCenter
-        Value: payments
+        Value: payments-core
--- context (unchanged in this PR) ---
Resources.LedgerDb: AWS::RDS::DBInstance, DBInstanceClass: !Ref DbInstanceClass, Engine: postgres, MultiAZ: true, StorageType: gp3, AllocatedStorage: 200
.github/workflows/deploy.yml: AWS_REGION: eu-west-1; `aws cloudformation deploy --stack-name payments-ledger` with no --parameter-overrides (template defaults apply)
--- live lookup results for this run (AWS Price List, eu-west-1) ---
AmazonRDS  SKU FX-RDS-01  usagetype EU-Multi-AZUsage:db.r6g.large    databaseEngine=PostgreSQL deploymentOption=Multi-AZ   0.500 USD per Hrs
AmazonRDS  SKU FX-RDS-03  usagetype EU-Multi-AZUsage:db.r6g.xlarge   databaseEngine=PostgreSQL deploymentOption=Multi-AZ   1.000 USD per Hrs
AmazonRDS  SKU FX-RDS-04  usagetype EU-UnusedBox:db.r6g.xlarge        databaseEngine=PostgreSQL deploymentOption=Multi-AZ   0.000 USD per Hrs
AmazonRDS  SKU FX-RDS-02  usagetype EU-RDS:Multi-AZ-GP3-Storage       volumeType=General Purpose-GP3 databaseEngine=PostgreSQL   0.250 USD per GB-Mo", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
{"id": "45236291-f71a-48f4-8a87-df72b52d7e8b", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"type": "chat_title", "title": "PR #57 RDS instance class cost impact analysis"}]}

{"id": "0869c494-35f7-463d-ad1c-8e54cd818da7", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "Bumping `DbInstanceClass` from `db.r6g.large` to `db.r6g.xlarge` on the `LedgerDb` Multi-AZ Postgres instance (eu-west-1) adds about **$365/month**, driven purely by the compute rate change:

| Component | Before (large) | After (xlarge) | Delta |
|---|---|---|---|
| Instance (Multi-AZ), $/hr | $0.500 | $1.000 | +$0.500/hr |
| Instance, monthly (×730 hrs) | $365.00 | $730.00 | **+$365.00/mo** |
| Storage, 200 GB gp3 @ $0.250/GB-mo | $50.00 | $50.00 | $0.00 |
| **Total** | **$415.00/mo** | **$780.00/mo** | **+$365.00/mo (~88%)** |

Notes:
- Storage is untouched by this PR (`AllocatedStorage: 200`, `StorageType: gp3` unchanged), so it doesn't move.
- The `EU-UnusedBox:db.r6g.xlarge` rate is $0.000/hr and doesn't apply here — the instance is actively deployed, not sitting unused.
- The `CostCenter` tag change (`payments` → `payments-core`) has no cost impact itself, though it will reclassify this instance's spend under `payments-core` in any cost allocation reports going forward.
- The deploy workflow passes no `--parameter-overrides`, so the template default (`xlarge`) takes effect on merge — nothing stops this from landing automatically.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}

| Component | Before (large) | After (xlarge) | Delta |

| **Total** | **$415.00/mo** | **$780.00/mo** | **+$365.00/mo (~88%)** |

Notes:

- The `EU-UnusedBox:db.r6g.xlarge` rate is $0.000/hr and doesn't apply here — the instance is actively deployed, not sitting unused.
